segments.text: 21 And he was driuen from the ſonnes of men, and his heart was made like the beaſtes, and his dwelling was with the wilde Aſſes: they fed him with graſſe like Oxen, & his body was wet with the dew of heauen, till he knew that the moſt hye God did rule ouer the kingdome of mē, and that he appointeth ouer it whom ſo euer he pleaſeth.
